generic_sampling_rules.text_short: Sample from a small pool of realistic short strings; 10% of values are near-variants (case change, one-character edit, truncation) of a pool value; 5% NULL when nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.text_name: Sample from a pool of realistic names; 10% near-variants (case, one-char edit, truncation); 5% NULL when nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.text_city: Sample from a pool of city names; 10% near-variants (case, one-char edit, truncation); 5% NULL when nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.text_county: Sample from a pool of county names; 10% near-variants (case, one-char edit, truncation); 5% NULL when nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.text_region: Sample from a pool of region names; 10% near-variants (case, one-char edit, truncation); 5% NULL when nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.text_food_type: Sample from a pool of cuisine types; 10% near-variants (case, one-char edit, truncation); 5% NULL when nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.int_pk: Sequential integers starting at 1, no NULL.
generic_sampling_rules.int_fk: Copy from parent key pool; 10% NULL when nullable; 10% orphan values not in parent pool when nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.int_house_number: Uniform integer in [1, 9999]; 5% NULL when nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.real_rating: Uniform real in [0.0, 5.0] rounded to 1 decimal; 5% NULL when nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.boundary_rule: For each listed literal, include the literal itself, one step below and one step above (numbers by step, text by case/one-char edit).
generic_sampling_rules.like_near_variant_rule: For each listed LIKE pattern, include the literal and 2-3 near-variants (case change, one-char edit, truncation).
generic_sampling_rules.null_rule: Every nullable column gets at least one NULL row per instance; NULL share follows the compact database share (default 5-10%).
generic_sampling_rules.duplicate_rule: For DISTINCT columns, 20-50% of values are duplicates of other rows.
generic_sampling_rules.unmatched_join_rule: For join columns, include parent rows without children and child rows with NULL or orphan foreign keys.

issues.evidence: The schema declares LOCATION RESTAURANT_ID as a foreign key referencing RESTAURANT(RESTAURANT_ID), but the RESTAURANT table has no column named RESTAURANT_ID (its PK is ID). The schema reader emits a dangling-FK warning (schema.py:120) and drops the FK, so the FK dependency is not enforced. The spec's dependencies list still lists LOCATION.RESTAURANT_ID -> RESTAURANT.ID, and the generated SQLite still has FK enforcement (foreign_keys=OFF) so integrity holds in practice, but the spec text is inconsistent with the actual DDL.
